faqs.heading: COMMON **QUESTIONS**
faqs.description: Quick answers to the things clients usually ask me before we start.

items.question: How long does a website take to build?
items.answer: A standard business website usually takes 1-3 weeks, while larger or more complex builds (apps, custom platforms) can take 4-8 weeks depending on scope. I'll always give you a clear timeline before we start.

items.question: Do you provide source files after the project?
items.answer: Yes. Once your project is complete and fully paid, you own everything — source code, designs, and files. You can hand it to any developer or agency afterward with zero lock-in.

items.question: How do I provide project details and pay?
items.answer: Just reach out through the contact form or email with a quick overview of your idea. After we agree on scope and pricing, I'll send a contract and invoice — payments are typically split into milestones (deposit + final).

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Absolutely. I work with clients around the world on a remote basis. Time zones are coordinated so communication stays smooth, and payment can be made via bank transfer or online payment platforms.

items.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
items.answer: Yes. I can rebuild or redesign an existing site to be faster, mobile-friendly, and more conversion-focused — whether it's WordPress, plain HTML, or a Shopify store. I'll audit it first and show you what can be improved.
